# Butter HYSA Comparator

> Local, deterministic cash-account comparisons for people and AI agents.
> Repository: https://github.com/mlo0352/hysacomp

- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md)
- [Agent guide and prompts](docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md)
- [Methodology](docs/METHODOLOGY.md)
- [Bank research audit](docs/BANK_REVIEW_2026-10-09.md)
- [Tool manifest](tool-manifest.json)
- [Scenario schema](schemas/scenario.schema.json)
- [Bank schema](schemas/banks.schema.json)
- [Fictional salary scenario](examples/working-person.yaml)
- [Bank snapshot](data/banks-2026-10-09.yaml)

Install with npm ci. Run npx tsx cli.ts --help. Inputs: YAML/JSON or supported legacy XML.
Outputs: raw JSON/CSV and SVG image. No API key, remote API or MCP server required.
Report source dates, baseline-relative earnings, model exclusions and assumptions.
